Eric Brotmann's walking away at 99% with CeeDee Lamb's 35.3-point performance as your execution baseline, and yeah, he fucked up benching Dalton Kincaid's 22.5 for Rhamondre Stevenson's 3.6, but when you're already up 37 points with Kyren Williams and Isaiah Likely still pending, your own incompetence barely registers as a speedbump. You needed a completely different roster and a different set of lineup decisions to even make this competitive—instead you got a clinic in how to sink yourself twice: once in the draft with Robinson's underperformance and again Sunday morning with the Johnston call that cost you a full touchdown you didn't have to lose.
